description: This PHP source file defines the EditTimesheetController class within the OrangeHRM system. It handles rendering and authorization logic for editing a timesheet, including retrieving timesheet data, verifying user permissions, and setting Vue component properties.

classes.name: EditTimesheetController
classes.description: Controller responsible for editing a timesheet, managing the pre-render setup and access control.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering, setting properties such as timesheet ID and ownership status.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Determines whether the current user has permission to access the editing functionality for a specific timesheet.
